annotations.title: Estimate Messenger marketing-message delivery and cost

description: Meta’s own estimate of how many marketing messages a budget would deliver from a Page and what it would cost, before anything is created. Free. Meta marks the metric “in development”, so treat it as a range.

adAccountId.description: ad account id (act_ prefix or digits)

dailyBudgetUsd.description: daily budget in the ad account's currency to estimate delivery for

lifetimeBudgetUsd.description: total budget in the ad account's currency to estimate delivery for

lifetimeDays.description: number of days the lifetime budget spans, for the estimate

pageId.description: sending Page; omit to use the shared Page

name: estimate_messenger_marketing_delivery
title: Estimate Messenger marketing-message delivery and cost
